why:
DOUBLE THE LIFELINK, AND MAKE WHITE DEVOTION REAL. drain-v1 established the drain axis (+0.0424 on kill_by_8 against an MDE of 0.0195, the first branch in 25 to move anything). This tests the multiplier on it.

TRUE CONVICTION is the single best card this deck can be handed. 'Creatures you control have double strike and lifelink' does four things at once here: it DOUBLES every lifelink trigger and therefore every drain trigger, since Sanguine Bond and Enduring Tenacity fire on the gain and not on the hit; it makes deathtouch lethal in the FIRST-STRIKE step, so a blocker dies before it deals damage and blocking becomes strictly bad; it is a non-Aura enchantment, so the commander or Starfield of Nyx animates it into a 6/6 that is never a dead card; and {W}{W}{W} is THREE WHITE PIPS, which is the devotion the pilot asked for.

DEVOTION IS A TWO-COLOUR PROBLEM IN A THREE-COLOUR DECK. Across the whole 99 the deck has W 37, B 22, U 14. Heliod needs devotion to white of 5 and gets it; Athreos needs white AND black of 7 and gets it; Thassa needs BLUE of 5 against 14 pips in the entire list and essentially never becomes a creature. Thassa stays for the {1}{U} unblockable grant, which works whether or not she is a creature, but nothing else in the deck should be paying blue for devotion that will not arrive.

THE TWO CUTS ARE THE WEAKEST BLUE CARDS AND NOTHING ELSE. Muddle the Mixture counters instants and sorceries ONLY -- the narrowest interaction in the list -- and its transmute costs {1}{U}{U} to find a two-drop. Hypnotic Siren is a 1/1. Enduring Curiosity is NOT cut despite being {2}{U}{U}: 'whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, draw a card' on a board of lifelink bodies is a draw engine, and it returns itself as an enchantment when it dies.

VIRTUE OF PERSISTENCE IS THE CHEAT-IN LINE THE PILOT ASKED FOR, printed on one card. The {1}{B} Adventure half is early removal plus two life -- which is a LIFEGAIN TRIGGER for every drain payoff -- and the {5}{B}{B} enchantment half is an upkeep reanimation engine. The deck already runs both cheat-in routes for it: Academy Rector searches ANY enchantment onto the battlefield when it dies, and Starfield of Nyx returns an enchantment from the graveyard every upkeep.

WHAT THIS BRANCH DELIBERATELY DOES NOT TEST. The pilot's evasion package -- Enter the Enigma, Pym Particles, Artful Dodge, Splash Portal -- is EXCLUDED because the goldfish has no blockers and reads 'can't be blocked' only in Aura and Equipment form. Evasion is worth exactly zero to this harness and can only measure as a loss, which is what sank reach-v1. That line is a FORGE question and must be tested with simulate, not here. Recorded rather than quietly dropped.

STILL NO TWO-CARD INFINITE. Neither add carries 'whenever an opponent loses life, you gain that much', and True Conviction is not a Game Changer, so the bracket floor holds.
